blurb: NOTE: Because we limit the number of people in each tour, this tours tends to sell out quickly. This tour takes you through the most haunted neighborhood in Denver. Historic Haunted Mansions, Scandals, and History, are the themes of this paranormal tour. NOTE: Although we don't go into any of the privately owned mansions, you will still have an opportunity to feel, and possibly see the presence of paranormal activity. Bring your smart phone. We often capture orbs and sometimes even shadow people. Paranormal activity is never guaranteed. Duration: 2 Hours. Distance: 1.7 Mile Walking Tour. The tour meets at 901 Sherman St, on the corner of 9th and Sherman, in front of the lighted, Archer Tower sign. Make sure to go to the Sherman side of the building. Note: Book Early, this tour tends to sell out quickly, during the Halloween Season.. Note: This is a rain or shine event. Note: we also offer this tour as an all-inclusive experience, with a boozy twist.
